column1: # Fuzz rounds before the sweep (out/sweep/rate.tsv takes over from there), one
# line per round as its lane's report or notes gave it. A fuzz lane adds its
# rounds here as it runs them. Columns: date (the round's day), lane, fuzzer
# (chainfuzz, playfuzz, rlfuzz, rawfuzz), round, sessions, rows checked,
# failing sessions, new causes (distinct causes the round found, fixed or not),
# source. "-" where the source does not say; divergences.sh computes new
# causes per 1,000 sessions only where both are known.
